title: Dogen's Vow - at Bozeman Zen Group
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up Eihei Koso Hotsugan Mon, the vow chant drawn from Dogen's writings, at a Bozeman Zen Group sesshin. Beginning with two members starting precept study, Nomon resolves to sit in vigil at a naval air base gate over the US boat strikes in the Caribbean, then teaches the sixth-century Chan master Zhiyi's breath instructions: anchor the mind in the belly, soften the body, and visualize breath moving through the pores. In the vow, Dogen's line that "we in the future shall be Buddhas" sits beside "already Buddha," and confession becomes a practice that melts obstacles at the root. Nomon closes by previewing the next morning's shosan ceremony, where Reb Anderson once allowed Nomon to say simply, "I have no question."
